lines.text: Many learners say: She is best student in our class.
Better: She is the best student in our class.
The! He is the best player.

data.wrong: She is best student in our class.
data.right: She is the best student in our class.

native.tip: Перед “best” нужен “the”: “She is the best student in our class.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “She is best student in our class”? 😅 По-русски артиклей нет: «она лучшая ученица в классе», поэтому “the” легко пропустить, но перед “best” он нужен. Правильно: “She is the best student in our class.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “the.” Перед best — the. Скажи вслух о своём друге: “He is the best …” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Before “best”, use “the”: “She is the best student in our class.”
en.caption: Do you also say “She is best student in our class”? 😅 Russian has no articles, so the little word before best is easy to drop, but English needs it. Correct: “She is the best student in our class.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
